title: P6-11: Threat Intelligence: throwaway-prefix proof on the shared root anth.us, and staging checks
description:
## Goal
threat-intelligence.anth.us and threat-intelligence-staging.anth.us are served by the NEW app in papyrus-production, with the records written by hand in the legacy zone Z02552332GG6AM25SFP73, a tested rollback, and proof that Anth.us production and the four other anth.us apps did not change.

## Context (FACT, read-only 2026-10-10)
- Legacy: app dzefa11i80jyq holds anth.us with prefixes threat-intelligence (main) and threat-intelligence-staging (staging). Zone records: CNAME threat-intelligence.anth.us and CNAME threat-intelligence-staging.anth.us (TTL 500) -> dsdc44yor9rfm.cloudfront.net; the shared validation CNAME `_61eb...`. The root anth.us (apex A alias, www CNAME), MX (mailchannels), TXT (openai), SES DKIM, googlehosted CNAME and the other apps' CNAMEs are not ours.
- Why the others cannot change: every association is its own object in its own app; the zone is only touched by name. Our new association lives in another account with its own certificate and its own validation token. The plan touches exactly four names: CREATE `_<new>.anth.us` (validation), UPSERT `threat-intelligence`, UPSERT `threat-intelligence-staging` (and, only in the fallback, Amplify deletes those two names when the legacy association is deleted). Evidence from 10 earlier DeleteDomainAssociation calls and the 2026-10-08 TI cutover (PPY-386123): Amplify deletes only the association's own host records and never the shared `_61eb` record.
- Two paths. PATH 1 (preferred, if PPY-52d455 shows cross-account same-name creation works): deploy the new Domain while the legacy association stays; add the validation CNAME; wait AVAILABLE; verify with `curl --resolve`; UPSERT the two CNAMEs (CNAME type kept, no MX at these names). Near-zero downtime. PATH 2 (fallback, proven on 2026-10-08): delete the legacy association first, then deploy; measured downtime about 6 minutes.
- DANGER: when the legacy association is later deleted (P6-13), Amplify may delete the two CNAMEs by name, which now point at the new app; see P6-13.
- Cognito callbacks: the new backend registers `<origin>/` and `<origin>/newsroom`; Google needs NO change at cutover (it only knows the Cognito domain).

## Exact steps
1. Blocked until PPY-52d455 (R1 result and recipe), P6-10 and P6-11 are done; delta copy after the freeze; P6-01 baselines re-captured within the hour (Anth.us hashes, zone, associations of all six apps).
2. PR on AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence: infra/site.json becomes the production truth (hostedZoneId Z02552332GG6AM25SFP73, domainName anth.us, domainPrefix threat-intelligence, stagingDomainPrefix threat-intelligence-staging, OAUTH list origin-only, production Cognito prefix). `cdk diff` against papyrus-production: expect ADD Domain (2 sub-domain settings, DependsOn both branches), MODIFY branch env; the GithubCiRole trust may gain `refs/heads/staging` (seen on 2026-10-07; Ryan accepts or rejects); NOTHING replaced, no Route 53, no legacy ARNs. The Git `staging` ref must be current.
3. Ryan yes: merge, `cdk deploy` (PATH 1) and read both subdomain dnsRecords and the validation record from `get-domain-association`. Ryan yes, legacy write: CREATE `_<new>.anth.us` CNAME (TTL 300, saved DELETE batch). Wait AVAILABLE for both sub-domains.
4. Verify before DNS with `curl -sI --resolve` for both hosts (200/307, cert issuer Amazon, SAN includes the host, serial not 0FE6E6DA and not 43663B95).
5. Ryan go/no-go, then UPSERT staging first, then production; saved restore batches (old dsdc44yor9rfm target) in the baseline folder. Record timestamps.
6. Checks: the 24-route text-hash and screenshot comparison against the baseline; 18 articles 200; video 307 then 206; /newsroom sign-in round trip from the public host; staging host redirects to sign-in with the guards; response headers (no noindex on production); rotate verification of the revalidate secret path.
7. ANTH.US PROOF (before/after identical): hashes of anth.us, www, /about/, /articles/ and cert serial 4011E19937BAEFB5718712CAE5777777 notAfter 2027-04-20; `get-domain-association d2hbn1ig6nqyhy anth.us` diff empty; `list-domain-associations` for d2hbn1ig6nqyhy, d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, d3epcqvzbxdaq, dfkbdffs2viq8, divicqm3nhcwt identical; zone diff vs P6-01 = only `_<new>` added and two CNAME targets changed; apex, www, MX, TXT, DKIM, `_61eb` byte-identical.

## Acceptance checks
- All of 6 and 7; downtime recorded (PATH 1 target under 2 minutes).

## Rollback
UPSERT the saved restore batches (old CNAME targets; the legacy association is intact and auto-build stays as is); stack update reverting the domain fields, or `delete-domain-association` on the new app (production profile); DELETE the validation CNAME only if the new association is also gone. PATH 2 rollback: `create-domain-association --app-id dzefa11i80jyq --domain-name anth.us --no-enable-auto-sub-domain --sub-domain-settings prefix=threat-intelligence,branchName=main prefix=threat-intelligence-staging,branchName=staging`, wait AVAILABLE, verify the old hash.

## Risks
R1; staging build must succeed before staging DNS moves; ACM validation timing; the GithubCiRole trust widening.

## Needs Ryan
Go/no-go, every legacy zone write, deploy yes, sign-ins, the downtime window if PATH 2.

## Common rules (Phase 6, PPY-7d8cd0)
- Read ~/Projects/Papyrus/AGENTS.local.md first. Assert the account with `aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text` before EVERY call: profile legacy = 335163751677, profile papyrus-production = 712236451410. Never use papyrus-development; papyrus-staging (494166748521) is not used by this phase.
- Every write needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Legacy is READ-ONLY except the steps this ticket names (each with a yes). No SCPs on legacy; never risk legacy access; no `cdk deploy` and no `ampx` against the legacy stacks of these sites.
- Never print secret values (names only; SSM values move by pipe, never to the terminal or a ticket). Ryan deletes retired resources. Do not touch Anth.us production d2hbn1ig6nqyhy or the other anth.us apps (apricity d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, babulus d3epcqvzbxdaq, tactus dfkbdffs2viq8, primus divicqm3nhcwt).
- Baselines and scratch live under ~/Projects/.baselines/phase6-<date>/ (outside any repo); clones go under ~/Projects/ and are deleted afterwards (disk is tight). Only kbs writes in the Papyrus checkout (never git add/commit there); never `git stash`.
- The committed infra/site.json in each site repo still describes the LEGACY stack until the cutover ticket; production deploys use an out-of-repo, domain-free copy (as PPY-aa93b3 did for p.apyr.us).
right_now_summary: The cutover awaits PPY-52d455, P6-10, and baseline recapture before DNS changes.
